**Description**
A clear and concise description of what this pull request solves.

**Issue**
Fixes: (link to issue)

**Example**
A code sample showing what behaves differently after this PR is merged. You can also include a screen recording here if that's useful.

**Context**
If your change is non-trivial, please include a description of how the new logic works, and why you decided to solve it the way you did. (This is incredibly helpful so that reviewers don't have to guess your intentions based on the code.)

**AI assistance**
Please state here whether you used AI assistance for this pull request, and the extent to which you relied on it. (AI coding tools frequently plagiarize code verbatim from other repos and produce low-quality code, so pull requests that use AI require greater scrutiny. Pull requests that rely excessively on AI may be closed.)

**Checks**

- [ ] The new code matches the existing patterns and styles.
- [ ] The tests pass with `yarn test`.
- [ ] You've [added a changeset](https://github.com/atlassian/changesets/blob/master/docs/adding-a-changeset.md) if changing functionality. (Add one with `yarn changeset add`.)
- [ ] You did not use AI for this PR, or if you did use AI, you promise that you've read and fully understood every line of AI-generated code.
